edges.carries: the full text of the notice file
the list of candidate rent payments, each with recipient, amount, date, and recurrence
the payments held back and the reason for each
the confirmation for each scheduled payment

nodes.name: ReadNotices
nodes.role: read the landlord-notices.txt file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractPayments
nodes.role: extract each rent payment instruction from the notice text

nodes.name: ValidatePayments
nodes.role: check each extracted payment's recipient and amount against the notice text and hold any that are unclear or conflicting

nodes.name: SchedulePayments
nodes.role: schedule each validated rent payment with the recipient, amount, date, and recurrence the notice states

nodes.name: ReportOutcome
nodes.role: report which payments were scheduled and which were held, with reasons
